# Dead Keys

> A typing game, back from the dead. Dead Keys rebuilds the 1980s typing games MasterType and Type Attack as a keyboard trainer: type each word before it lands, and the game notices which keys you miss and drills them.

Dead Keys runs in the browser with no account. Progress stays in the player's browser. The only server route is an AI drill endpoint (/api/drill) that accepts weak keys and recent speed, nothing else. It is not a public API.

- [Play Dead Keys](https://dead-keys.vercel.app/): the game. It needs JavaScript and a keyboard (QWERTY in this version).
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/earlgreyhot1701D/dead-keys): how it works, how it was built with Kiro, decision records, credits and licenses. MIT License.
- [Maker](https://clewlabs.org): L. Cordero.
